answer: Honeypot tasks with known-wrong answers, slashed on a failed audit: a clone that bites loses the bond and the epoch. The epoch beacon sets which jobs are traps, so an operator cannot learn the pattern from one round. Cause and effect: 1 trap in 20 jobs means a 500-clone farm walks into roughly 25 forfeitures an epoch, more than the payout. The timber of the ledger holds every slash, and a pigment of fresh labels does not hide the same payload.
